{{Top|leg}}
'''Yiszte''' was a country on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Essowyn]], in direct confrontation with [[Tresycht]] for control of the [[Thergum Pits]]. The nation was subjugated by Tresycht, with the aid of equipment and security forces provided by [[Messert Mines Corporation]].
